title: The Perfect Young Lady
overview: Itsuki, an ordinary guy, crosses paths with Hinako, a wealthy, perfect girl who is his polar opposite.

title: Caretaker Day 1
overview: Itsuki starts his first day as Hinako's caretaker and experiences life at a top-class school.

title: Reunion
overview: Itsuki is reunited with Miyakojima Narika, whose standoffish demeanor prevents her from making friends.

title: Lies and Secrets
overview: Itsuki grows closer to Hinako after she has a fainting spell.

title: Kidnap Me
overview: Itsuki attends a business luncheon with Hinako.

title: Tennoji Mirei's Proposal
overview: Mirei makes an appealing offer to Itsuki.

title: A Lady's Concerns
overview: Hinako is grouchy after Itsuki spends the night out, and Mirei seems anxious about getting married.

title: No Lies
overview: Mirei confronts Itsuki about the secrets he's been keeping.

title: The Lady's Day Off
overview: Itsuki takes Mirei on a much-needed day out.

title: The Plan to Free Narika From Isolation
overview: Hinako and Itsuki try several strategies to make Narika more approachable to her classmates.
